name: Smoked Salmon Chowder
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Place stock pot over medium heat, add oil.
Add carrots, onions, celery, stirring until onions turn clear.
Add tarragon and salmon stock to deglaze bottom of pan.
Stir in smashed potatoes, smoked salmon. Continue to stir and bring to a simmer.

culture.text: Chowder is a type of thick soup prepared with milk or cream, a roux, and seafood or vegetables. Oyster crackers or saltines may accompany chowders as a side item, and cracker pieces may be dropped atop the dish.
